reviewerStanding: INDEPENDENT. I did not author the subject, its predecessor, or either verdict it applies. I owe the subject nothing. This is not a coordinator-decision review and it decides nothing about the actor question.

verdictBasis.statement: REJECT at four blockers. Every blocker is the same family: a flat, mechanically checkable claim the artifact makes about ITS OWN bytes or about a cited source's bytes, which does not replicate. No blocker touches the design. The design's load-bearing content is sound and, on the points this review tested, materially stronger than v1's.
verdictBasis.whatThisVerdictIsNOT: It is NOT a finding against the actor analysis, the consent model, the report schema, the outcome structure, the redaction guarantee, or the degraded-input specification. It is NOT a finding that the artifact decided the actor question - it did not, and that is verified below. It is NOT a finding that the artifact carries a DR-105 permission token - the confinement property replicates exactly.
verdictBasis.v1BlockersAreGone: Both v1 blockers are REPAIRED at v2's bytes and both repairs were verified against primary sources rather than taken on the predecessor verdict's word. See mandatedChecks.v1BlockerClosure.
verdictBasis.theShapeOfTheFailure: v1 was rejected for two arithmetic/measurement defects. v2 repairs both, then introduces four fresh defects of exactly that class - three of them inside the very blocks whose function is to account for the repair (repairLog, recordedInputs.discipline). The successor's self-accounting is where it fails, not its subject matter.
verdictBasis.acceptGate: All four blockers are single-sentence or single-clause corrections against measurements already recorded in the artifact. None requires a design change, a new measurement campaign, or the actor decision. A v3 correcting them is reviewable on the same finding-set.
verdictBasis.scoringNote: Scored by FINDING-SET against v2's bytes, not by exit codes and not by comparison of prose volume. No checker was run.

Method: case-insensitive-match / case-sensitive-mismatch scan of v2's string values against the flattened string values of the DR-105 candidate, files 02/03/04, control-protocol-contract.v2 and component-manifest-schemas.v2, then manual confirmation that each surviving hit sits inside quotation marks and is attributed. (1) v2 quotes DR-105 as 'allocated to this COMPONENT'; DR-105's PT-FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE meaning reads 'allocated to this component for its declared state class.' - lowercase. (2) v2 quotes DR-105 as 'the component's OWN immutable installed tree'; DR-105's PT-FS-READ-COMPONENT meaning reads 'the component's own immutable installed tree' - lowercase. (3) v2 quotes its own CA-4 definition as 'any network send or receive BY DOCTOR'; /consentModel/consentableActionClasses CA-4 covers reads 'Any network send or receive by doctor - ...' - lowercase.
blockers.whyThisIsNotCosmetic: In (1) and (2) the capitalized words are the exact words the argument turns on. The sentence's force is 'PT-FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE is scoped to ... allocated to this COMPONENT, and doctor's audit record is allocated to no component' - the stress on COMPONENT is the author's inference presented as the source's emphasis. A reader is led to believe DR-105 itself stressed the word that defeats doctor's fit. A reviewer grepping the quoted string at the cited digest gets zero hits.
blockers.whyBlockerNotAdvisory: The falsified sentence is the universal 'The ONLY normalization this artifact applies anywhere is to hard-wrapped markdown' - a flat claim about the artifact's own bytes in a discipline block, which is v1's B2 class. It is aggravated by being the cure the artifact declares for a v1 finding, violated in the same build that declares it, and by landing inside /actorMismatch, the block the artifact itself asks to be read adversarially for exactly this kind of inflection.
blockers.scopeOfTheDefect: BOUNDED AND SMALL. Three fragments. Both declared block carriages (registerRowQuoted, doctorTextCarriedVerbatim) are clean of it, and I verified doctorTextCarriedVerbatim byte-exact element-for-element at current bytes. The systematic scan surfaced no other genuine instance; all other case-divergent spans were shared corpus boilerplate or sentence-boundary artifacts, not quotations.

Every underlying substantive claim replicates: PT-FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE really is scoped to a per-component namespace, PT-FS-READ-COMPONENT really is bounded to the component's own tree, and CA-4 really is defined as network send/receive by doctor. The mismatch argument is unaffected.
blockers.correction: Restore the source's characters inside the quotation marks and move the emphasis outside them - e.g. "scoped to the host-owned state namespace 'allocated to this component for its declared state class', and doctor's audit record is allocated to NO component".

advisories.class: residual asymmetry in the three candidate resolutions; tested for smuggling and NOT found to smuggle
advisories.whatITested: Structural parallelism, relative width, evaluative language, and whether the artifact's own groundwork pre-builds any one option.

Widths are comparable and do not favor any option - costs A 1093 / B 1156 / C 726 characters; statedNeutrally A 279 / B 340 / C 284; whatItWouldDoToThisArtifact A 188 / B 202 / C 112. The per-class decomposition is independently necessary to establish that the mismatch is per-class rather than global - it is the evidence for the ROOT finding, not an implementation of C. actorMismatchSmugglingAttack.instruction: Attack actorMismatch for smuggling: does any sentence decide the actor question while appearing to describe it? Are the three candidate resolutions comparable, or is one written to win?
actorMismatchSmugglingAttack.outcome: NO SMUGGLING FOUND. This is the artifact's strongest block and it survives adversarial reading.

sentencesITestedAsCandidateSmuggles.text: 'If host surfaces ARE subject to the vocabulary, then doctor declares no tokens anywhere and, under closure, its ENTIRE default posture is denied by absence and doctor cannot run at all.'
sentencesITestedAsCandidateSmuggles.whyISuspectedIt: 'doctor cannot run at all' is a reductio, and a reductio against one branch functions as an argument for the other.
sentencesITestedAsCandidateSmuggles.whyItIsNotASmuggle: It is scoped expressly to CURRENT bytes ('THE DILEMMA HAS NO THIRD BRANCH ON THE ARTIFACTS' CURRENT BYTES') and it is a correct derivation from DR-105's own closure rule, which I verified: /permissionVocabulary/closure states the set is 'CLOSED in the strong sense: a token outside it is not unrecognized and ignored, it is a refusal'. Under closure, absence is denial. Option A exists precisely to change those bytes, so the reductio bears on the status-quo reading rather than on Option A. The field closes: 'Both branches are recorded because the coordinator must choose between them, not because either is adopted here.'

sentencesITestedAsCandidateSmuggles.text: 'This contract does not gate its default posture and does not propose to: the four default properties are asserted as PROPERTIES of a host surface, not as permissions it was granted.'
sentencesITestedAsCandidateSmuggles.whyISuspectedIt: The artifact continues to operate under the framing Option B would ratify while the decision is pending - which is provisional adoption if left undisclosed.
sentencesITestedAsCandidateSmuggles.whyItIsNotASmuggle: It is disclosed in the same breath: 'Whether that framing survives is the routed decision.' The artifact names its own operative framing as contingent rather than presenting it as settled. A contract must ship some posture while a decision is pending; naming which one and marking it contingent is the honest handling.

sentencesITestedAsCandidateSmuggles.text: Records that the coherence review's advisory favored a negative answer on host-surface subjection, attributes it, and declines it.
sentencesITestedAsCandidateSmuggles.whyItIsNotASmuggle: The attribution is explicit and the refusal is reasoned: 'That view is recorded here as the reviewer's, attributed, and it is NOT adopted by this artifact: a reviewer's advisory is not a coordinator decision, and this contract would be deciding the question by echoing it.' The corresponding repairLog entry (ADV-2) carries the disposition 'CARRIED AND ATTRIBUTED - EXPRESSLY NOT ADOPTED'. Declining to echo a favorable reviewer advisory is the opposite of smuggling.

actorMismatchSmugglingAttack.threeCandidateResolutions: COMPARABLE. Structurally parallel (identical four members each), comparable width, and the heaviest cost paragraph belongs to the option the cited reviewer advisory favored. No option is written to win. Two residual asymmetries are recorded at advisory A4, neither of which advantages the option it attaches to.

reviewSummary: REJECT at four blockers, none of them a design defect. v2 closes both of v1's blockers and closes them well - the CLI_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES count was independently re-measured rather than taken on the verdict's word (16 confirmed at the recorded digest, which replicates), and the false DR-105 absence claim was corrected in place with the error quoted rather than quietly deleted. The three properties this review was told to confirm all hold: permissionRef stays a reserved binding point and is never populated; DR-105 token confinement is exact at 27 occurrences with zero outside /actorMismatch and /repairLog; and the artifact mints no D9 or exit value anywhere. The artifact did NOT decide the actor question - it names it, routes it to a named decider at ID-DEP-12, states three genuinely comparable resolutions, withdraws v1's unsatisfiable totality requirement rather than reinterpreting it, records twelve findings BLOCKED rather than closing them by adopting a reading, and expressly declines to echo the reviewer advisory that pointed one way. I attacked actorMismatch for smuggling and found none. What fails is the successor's self-accounting. Its repair log recites '17-member 0 occurrences' over bytes that contain it three times, two of them in the same repair entry. Its completeness claim - 'a JSON pointer it does not name is byte-identical to v1', backed by a recited mechanical verification - is falsified by seven undisclosed additions to the block that instructs this reviewer. It miscounts two ENFORCED-BY-CONSTRUCTION cells as two tokens when one token carries them, and contradicts itself three sentences later. And the quotation-fidelity rule v2 declares to cure a v1 finding is violated by three quotations that put the author's emphasis in a source's mouth at the exact words the argument turns on. Every underlying measurement is right; every claim ABOUT those measurements is what does not replicate. All four are single-clause corrections against figures already in the artifact, need no design change and no actor decision, and a v3 is reviewable on the same finding-set.
